name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
description: The Fulbright Program is the U.S. government's flagship international educational exchange program, providing funding for graduate study, research, and teaching in over 160 countries. It fosters mutual understanding between Americans and people of other countries.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
description: Awarded to outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge. One of the most prestigious scholarships in the world, it selects for exceptional intellect, leadership, and a commitment to improving lives of others.

name: Rhodes Scholarship
description: The Rhodes Scholarship is the oldest and most prestigious international scholarship programme, enabling exceptional young people from around the world to study at the University of Oxford. Rhodes Scholars are selected for their intellect, character, leadership, and commitment to service.

name: Chevening Scholarship
description: Chevening is the UK government's global scholarship programme offering awards to outstanding scholars with leadership potential from around the world. Chevening Scholars have a demonstrable impact on their communities and countries.

name: DAAD Scholarship
description: DAAD offers a wide range of scholarships for international students and researchers wishing to study or conduct research in Germany. Germany's public universities are largely tuition-free for all students, making DAAD one of the most cost-effective global scholarships.

name: Australia Awards Scholarship
description: Australia Awards Scholarships provide opportunities for people from developing countries in the Indo-Pacific and beyond to undertake full-time undergraduate or postgraduate studies at Australian institutions.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees are integrated international study programmes delivered by a consortium of higher education institutions from different countries. Students study in at least two countries and gain double/multiple degrees.

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
description: The MEXT Scholarship is the Japanese government scholarship programme for international students, covering undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs at Japanese national universities, with full financial support and Japanese language training.

name: Commonwealth Scholarship
description: Commonwealth Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals from Commonwealth countries to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. They are funded by the UK Department for International Development.

name: Korean Government Scholarship (KGSP)
description: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) is offered by the Korean Government to international students to provide opportunities to study at higher educational institutions in Korea and to develop global leaders with a friendly view of Korea.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
description: The Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) is a full scholarship programme sponsored by China's Ministry of Education, covering undergraduate, master's, doctoral programs, and general scholar programs at designated Chinese universities.

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
description: The Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship (Vanier CGS) program is designed to attract and retain world-class doctoral students and to establish Canada as a global centre of excellence in research and higher learning.

name: Rotary Foundation Global Grant
description: Rotary Global Grants fund large international activities with sustainable, measurable outcomes in one or more of our six areas of focus. Global Grants can fund vocational training teams, humanitarian projects, and scholarships for graduate-level study.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship
description: The Aga Khan Foundation provides a limited number of scholarships each year for postgraduate studies to outstanding students from developing countries who have no other means of financing their studies. Awards are made as a combination of grant and loan.

name: Schwarzman Scholars
description: Schwarzman Scholars is a highly selective program at Tsinghua University in Beijing designed to prepare the next generation of global leaders for a world in which China plays a central role. It is modelled after the Rhodes Scholarship.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarship
description: The Swedish Institute Study Scholarships are highly competitive scholarships for global professionals who want to pursue a Master's degree in Sweden. The programme targets future leaders and change-makers who want to make a difference in their home countries.

name: Orange Tulip Scholarship (Netherlands)
description: The Orange Tulip Scholarship (OTS) is a scholarship programme initiated by the Dutch Ministry of Education and offered by Dutch universities of applied sciences and research universities in the Netherlands.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
provider: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
description: The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are aimed at young researchers from abroad who have completed a master's degree or PhD and at foreign artists who have completed an arts diploma/degree. They promote international exchange and research cooperation.

name: New Zealand Excellence Awards
description: New Zealand Excellence Awards are awarded to exceptional international students who plan to study at postgraduate level in New Zealand. The awards recognise and support those who demonstrate academic excellence and the potential to contribute to their home countries.

name: Eni Award
description: The Eni Award supports outstanding research in energy transition, climate change, decarbonization, and sustainability for PhD students and young researchers studying in Italy.

name: ADB–JSP Scholarship
description: The ADB-JSP provides opportunities for qualified citizens of ADB borrowing member countries to undertake postgraduate study at participating academic institutions in the Asia-Pacific region, contributing to sustainable development.

name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarship
description: The Heinrich Böll Foundation offers scholarships to politically engaged students committed to green politics and the principles of ecology, democracy, solidarity, and non-violence. Open to both German and international students.

name: Turkish Government Scholarship (Türkiye Burslari)
provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities
description: Türkiye Bursları is a prestigious government scholarship offered to international students for academic degrees at Turkish universities. It covers undergraduate through doctoral programs and includes language training.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
description: The Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme is designed to increase the number of foreign students in Hungary and strengthen educational cooperation between Hungary and partner countries worldwide.

name: Taiwan MOE Scholarship
description: Taiwan's Ministry of Education Scholarship is designed to help international students of outstanding academic excellence study in Taiwan. Recipients study at prestigious Taiwanese universities.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars is one of the world's largest fully endowed graduate scholarship programs, providing funding for graduate students at Stanford University. It selects future leaders committed to creating positive change in the world.

name: MasterCard Foundation Scholars Program
description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program is dedicated to supporting talented but economically marginalized young people, primarily from Sub-Saharan Africa, to access high-quality education and leadership development.

name: Harvard University Financial Aid
description: Harvard is committed to meeting 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted undergraduate students, regardless of nationality. Graduate schools also offer extensive fellowships and need-based aid programs.

name: Franco-British Council Scholarship
description: The Franco-British Council Scholarship supports research exchanges and collaborative projects between France and the UK. It is ideal for students conducting joint research, attending conferences, or undertaking short-term placements.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
provider: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
description: SINGA is a prestigious scholarship for international students to pursue PhD studies in Singapore at A*STAR Research Institutes, the National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, or Singapore University of Technology and Design.

name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship
description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program supports mid-career professionals from developing member countries of the World Bank to pursue a Master's degree related to development at a participating university.

name: Endeavour Leadership Program (Australia)
description: The Endeavour Leadership Program is the Australian Government's internationally competitive, merit-based scholarship program providing opportunities for high achieving individuals to undertake study, research, or professional development in Australia.

name: Russian Government Scholarship
description: The Russian Government offers scholarships to foreign citizens to study at leading Russian universities. The programme covers full tuition and provides a monthly stipend, though students may need to separately arrange accommodation.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (France)
provider: Campus France / French Ministry of Foreign Affairs
description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to pursue master's or doctoral degree programs.

name: NUS Research Scholarship
description: The NUS Research Scholarship supports PhD candidates conducting research at NUS, one of Asia's top universities. Scholars are selected based on academic excellence and research potential.
